chunks: And he who confines it will surely come to grief.

key_terms.خَابَ: to come to grief or be unsuccessful

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to confine the Sunnah in Surah Ash-Shams?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a warning against those who obscure the Prophet's teachings (Sunnah) or the light of guidance, ensuring it remains confined to the elite or altered by power. It underscores the communal responsibility to preserve and manifest the authentic Sunnah, linking the fate of the individual to their fidelity to the divine light revealed through the Prophet.
